messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a regional rollforward of routing weights on the edge to nudge traffic from eu-west to na-west for a config-led content experiment. Target start 21:00 UTC, 5% increments every 3m per POP, total ~30m per region. No maintenance window required, just quiet window ops.

sanjay: Ack. Who's executing the weight updates? and who is primary for rollback?

maya: I'll perform the weight updates via the admin tool. @eli you're primary for rollback if we see error spikes; @tess can help with logs and backend health. Ramon on call for network anomalies.

eli: I can be on rollback. What's the rollback command? paste for quick copy please.

maya: Use the steward UI or CLI quick command. CLI snippet: ```redwood route shift --from eu-west --to na-west --pop $POP --percent 5 --step 3m --dry-run=false```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled shift job created by maya at 21:00 UTC. Job ID: shift-2305123456. Notifications will go to #eng-platform.

tess: For smoke, I'll run these checks right after each POP completes: 1) 99th p99 latency to edge origin < 220ms 2) error rate < 0.5% 3) synthetic traces for KV cache hits look stable. Command: ```scripts/smoke/edge-smoke --pop $POP --quick```

ramon: Network note — DNS TTL for the steering records is 60s; good to go. Make sure we don't change the origin A records mid-shift.

maya: Good catch. We'll avoid origin swaps. Also doing canary-probe set: 10 requests/s from eu-west to na-west path. If p95 latency regresses > 15% or error spikes 5x, rollback.

eli: How do we signal rollback? Manual CLI or button?

maya: Manual only. Rollback CLI: ```redwood route rollback --job shift-2305123456 --to-last-stable``` I'll execute and post updates.

sanjay: Add a runbook checklist in thread for quick copy: pre-checks, run, post-smoke, rollback steps. I'll paste after.

maya: Pre-checks: - Confirm autoscaling headroom >= 20% in na-west - Confirm KV cache warm for popular prefixes - Confirm no active deployments touching the same POPs - Confirm oncall coverage (eli + ramon)

maya: Run: - Start job at 21:00 UTC - Monitor per-POP metrics in console and the smoke script output - Hold each step 3m and wait for smoke OK before continuing

maya: Post-smoke: - Tag job as complete in steward - Update change log and notify product - Keep increased monitoring for 2h

ramon: I'm standing by network side. If any BGP flaps or route anomalies show, I'll call for pause/rollback immediately.

eli: I'll be online from 20:45 UTC. If I see rollback conditions I'll post `ROLLBACK: immediate` and run the CLI.

ops-bot: reminder: quiet-window begins 20:50 UTC. Please avoid unrelated deployments until shift completes.

maya: Thanks all. Will post a short status update at T+15m and again at completion. If anyone wants to join the call, I'll open a Zoom at 20:55 UTC (optional).

tess: 👍 copying smoke checklist into a gist and will reference during running.

sanjay: Thanks team. No objections from me. Proceeding as scheduled.

maya: rolling in 10m. posting live notes below as we go.
